title: Object Storage: monthly amendment limit
content:
Object Storage monthly amendment limit is defined as follows: Maximum accepted capacity amendments per holding in a UTC calendar month; integer.

| Contract tier | Monthly amendment limit |
| --- | --- |
| Northbridge Object Storage 5 TB | monthly amendment limit: 12 |
| Northbridge Object Storage 10 TB | monthly amendment limit: 12 |
| Northbridge Object Storage 25 TB | monthly amendment limit: 12 |
| Northbridge Object Storage 50 TB | monthly amendment limit: 12 |
| Northbridge Object Storage 100 TB | monthly amendment limit: 12 |
| Northbridge Object Storage 250 TB | monthly amendment limit: 12 |

## Tier reference

For Northbridge Object Storage 5 TB, the monthly amendment limit entry is 12.
